data.summary: Haocheng Mei et al. improve JEV entailment reranking with span readouts and selective adaptation, achieving 53.39% MC11 accuracy while reducing trainable parameters by over 50%. Mean-span pooling and selective LoRA updates in attention and DeltaNet projections yield consistent gains over all-module baselines.
data.abstract: Haocheng Mei et al. improve JEV entailment reranking with span readouts and selective adaptation, achieving consistent accuracy gains while reducing trainable parameters.
data.introduction: Haocheng Mei et al. improve JEV entailment reranking with span readouts and selective adaptation, achieving consistent accuracy gains while reducing trainable parameters.
data.conclusion: Selective adaptation retains LoRA updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing FFN adapters, improving NeoHorse-1-4B MC11 accuracy and reducing trainable parameters by over 50%.
